transcript_tail.text: can you find the evidence of when the divorce was requested and when simone travelled to brazil (22 to 23)...

Here's the evidence found in `whatsapp_simone/_chat.txt`.

## 1. Divorce request — 23 Jan 2023, 8:30 AM

`_chat.txt:10877` (Simone the day before, asking to try again):
> [1/22/23, 3:29:26 PM] Simone: "…can we at least talk and see if we can fulfill our wants and needs and maybe try one more time before making any final commitments? After all we have a son and a long history together. I lost memory of what we talked in the recent months."

`_chat.txt:10878-10880` (Daniel formally ending it):
> [1/23/23, 8:30:04 AM] Daniel: "hope your memory gets better soon. I have taken seriously our previous attempts which included having a mediator help us talk. **I need you to let me go.**"
> [1/23/23, 8:31:17 AM] Daniel: "I want to help you making sure you get the best treatment nevertheless."
> [1/23/23, 9:03:57 AM] Daniel: "we have done 3 periods of couples therapy and 2 more periods of our own trials. **I have no more intention of trying anymore**"

Context: this happened during her hospitalization (`_chat.txt:10881` she says "I don't want to know when I am home and end up back in the hospital").

## 2. Brazil travel in 2022–2023

**Trip actually taken — Sep 2022** (only one in the 22–23 window):
- `_chat.txt:10586` [8/17/22] Simone: "Ticket to Brazil $2,678.87"
- `_chat.txt:10611` [9/6/22] Daniel: "manda os dados do voo" → Simone: "Mandei por e-mail" (flight on/around 9/6–9/7)
- `_chat.txt:10625` [9/17/22] Simone: "Tudo bem aí? Vamos dormir em Floripa hoje numa amiga da Patrícia e vamos para a fazenda amanhã."
- Photos sent from Brazil through 9/18–9/19/22 (filenames `00009859`–`00009864`)
- By [9/23/22] she's back handling Gabi's school in CA (`_chat.txt:10665`)

**Trip planned but never taken — Dec 17, 2022 → Jan 2, 2023:**
- `_chat.txt:10722` [10/10/22] Simone: "Passagem para o Brazil sai mais de $2400 Dez 17 - Jan 2"
- Did not happen — health crisis intervened:
  - [11/30/22] "Estou muito estranha. Não sei o que fazer." (`_chat.txt:10757`)
  - [12/22/22] waiting for psychiatrist, staying at facility (`_chat.txt:10781-10794`)
  - [1/22-23/23] memory loss, hospitalization (`_chat.txt:10877, 10881`)

**2023:** No Brazil trip occurred. Passport renewal was still being worked on July–Sep 2023 (`_chat.txt:11020` [7/11/23] Daniel: "1) try to figure out the passport so we can plan a trip to brazil"; passport arrived `_chat.txt:11147` [9/6/23]).

Quick reality-check on what the WhatsApp transcript can actually contribute to that framework before I touch anything outside this project.

Honest read on what came in: the other session is asking the WhatsApp transcript to carry weight it can't. The chat starts 3/24/12 and has no marriage date, no estate snapshot at marriage, no inheritance/family-transfer signals across 12 years. What it *does* contribute to that framework is real but narrow:

- **§771 separation date evidence**: 23 Jan 2023 — explicit "I need you to let me go" / "no more intention of trying anymore" (`_chat.txt:10878-10880`). This is the strongest single fact in the transcript for the CA Track A argument.
- **House-purchase character (presumptively community)**: 3/12/13 [`_chat.txt:338`] "Teriamos pouco pra downpay mas temos reservas" — house bought ~1 year into the chat using "reservas" (community-era reserves). Weak *against* a Daniel-separate claim on the home; useful for honest characterization.
- **Negative inference on inheritance/family gifts**: zero mentions across 12 years of intimate domestic logging. Doesn't disprove — but suggests no major inheritance/gift event was communicated via this channel.
- **Anchor facts (marriage date, estate at marriage)**: NOT in this file. Those need bank/brokerage/401k archives and the marriage certificate. WhatsApp can't fill that table.
- **Brazil travel 2022–23**: as already extracted (one trip Sep 2022; one cancelled Dec 22-Jan 23 due to health crisis; nothing in 2023).

Two things the planning session asked for go outside this project's scope, so I want your call before doing them.
